generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily executed and completed as a prime contractor of at least one contract and its extensions pertaining to Routine / Preventive / Breakdown Maintenance works of electrical system of any Thermal power plant of 210 MW or above of value not less than Rs.89.26 lakhs (excluding GST) in any one year during the preceding five financial years. The intended bidder shall upload the scanned copy of original satisfactory work done certificate from Government Organization / Reputed private organization issued by competent authority in any of the preceding five years. Work done of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10 % per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited.

The intending bidder in his name should have a minimum annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.357.02 lakhs (excluding GST) in any of the two years of preceding five years and should upload the scanned copy of original latest audited balance sheets including profit and loss account for preceding five completed financial years countersigned by charted accountant as documentary evidence (Financial turnover of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall hold a valid Class-I Electrical contractor license issued by Electrical Inspectorate OR competent authority. If the electrical license is issued by other than State Government of Karnataka, the bidder should get Electrical License OR Consent Letter from Electrical Inspectorate to Government of Karnataka within two months from the date of issue of Work order. A Declaration to this effect shall be furnished by the intending bidder along with the bid as per ANNEXURE II.
